purpose: Generate the first editable island as a coherent overworld canvas composed from large editable exterior scene rectangles.
scenePlacementRules: Exterior scenes occupy rectangles on the overworld canvas and draw live SceneMap thumbnails.
Scene borders must line up with neighboring exterior scenes before ghost-border baking.
Interior, cave, dungeon, and event scenes remain in the scene bank and are linked by transitions.
Canvas edits should support zoom, pan, rectangle move, rectangle resize, and thumbnail refresh.
